reason: An MCP stdio server that exposes Jujutsu version-control operations, including repository inspection, history mutation, bookmark management, and remote fetch or push, as DSH tools.

summaries.zh: 通过 MCP 将 Jujutsu 命令行版本控制操作暴露为工具，支持查看仓库状态、管理变更与书签以及执行远程同步。
summaries.en: Exposes Jujutsu version-control operations through MCP tools for inspecting repositories, managing changes and bookmarks, and synchronizing with remotes.

capabilities: Read Jujutsu repository status, history, and diffs
Create, describe, commit, edit, abandon, undo, and rebase Jujutsu changes
Manage bookmarks and fetch or push changes to remotes
Run selected general Jujutsu commands through an MCP tool
